name: Braveheart Academy
source:
You're a college student enrolling in the prestigious International Braveheart Academy. You'll meet an array of quirky, cute, and even awkward characters! There's a girl for everyone here in this academy, and you hope to find love with the one. Or who knows.... maybe even everyone!?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/chrys_lair/about]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名即将进入名门学府——国际勇心学院就读的大学生。在这里，你会遇见许多性格古怪、可爱，甚至有些不善交际的角色！学院里总有适合每个人的女孩，你也希望能找到与命中注定之人的爱情。又或者，谁知道呢……也许会是所有人！？

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/chrys_lair/about]Patreon[/url]]
